name: print-social-navy-thank-you-slide-with-follow-pill
title: Navy sign-off slide with 'Thanks for watching', follow pill and contact rows
whatItIs: A deep navy slide with a huge white sans headline where a tilted blue thumbs-up pill and a blue '+ Follow' pill sit between the words, a small thumbnail of a website peeks in place of a word, and two hairline rows list Email and Web with values on the right.
whatItMeans: Friendly and social-native; the sign-off mimics platform buttons so viewers feel invited to follow.
techniques: Insert UI-like pills (like, follow) between words of a headline.
Replace a word with a live thumbnail of the work.
List contact details as hairline rows with labels left and values right.
Use one vivid blue on navy.

vocabulary.definition: A button-like graphic embedded within a headline.
A list line separated by a thin rule.
A small image standing in for a word.
A graphic urging viewers to follow.
